# secobserve_product (Data Source)

Looks up a product by id or exact name.

Use it to reference a product managed elsewhere, and to read the runtime information that the `secobserve_product` resource deliberately does not carry: the active observation counts and the flags describing what kinds of findings the product has.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Reference a product managed elsewhere, and read the runtime information the
# secobserve_product resource deliberately does not carry.
data "secobserve_product" "checkout" {
  name = "checkout-service"
}

output "open_critical_findings" {
  value = data.secobserve_product.checkout.active_critical_observation_count
}

output "security_gate_passed" {
  value = data.secobserve_product.checkout.security_gate_passed
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) Numeric id of the product. Supply either this or `name`.
- `name` (String) Exact name of the product. Supply either this or `id`.

Matching is exact and case-sensitive, even though SecObserve's own filter is a substring match.

### Read-Only

- `active_critical_observation_count` (Number) Number of active observations of critical severity.
- `active_high_observation_count` (Number) Number of active observations of high severity.
- `active_low_observation_count` (Number) Number of active observations of low severity.
- `active_medium_observation_count` (Number) Number of active observations of medium severity.
- `active_none_observation_count` (Number) Number of active observations of `None` severity.
- `active_unknown_observation_count` (Number) Number of active observations of unknown severity.
- `cpe23` (String) CPE 2.3 name identifying the product.
- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `has_cloud_resource` (Boolean) Whether the product has observations concerning cloud resources.
- `has_component` (Boolean) Whether the product has observations concerning components.
- `has_docker_image` (Boolean) Whether the product has observations concerning container images.
- `has_endpoint` (Boolean) Whether the product has observations concerning endpoints.
- `has_kubernetes_resource` (Boolean) Whether the product has observations concerning Kubernetes resources.
- `has_potential_duplicates` (Boolean) Whether the product has observations concerning potential duplicate observations.
- `has_source` (Boolean) Whether the product has observations concerning source files.
- `issue_tracker_active` (Boolean) Whether observations are pushed to an issue tracker.
- `license_policy` (Number) Id of the applied license policy.
- `product_group` (Number) Id of the product group, if any.
- `product_group_name` (String) Name of the product group, if any.
- `purl` (String) Package URL identifying the product.
- `repository_default_branch` (Number) Id of the default branch.
- `repository_default_branch_name` (String) Name of the default branch.
- `repository_prefix` (String) Base URL of the source repository.
- `security_gate_active` (Boolean) Whether the security gate is evaluated. Null means the setting is inherited.
- `security_gate_passed` (Boolean) Whether the product currently passes its security gate.
